data.gender_notes: अमन is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hindu mythology, the name अमन (Aman) signifies that which is immortal and imperishable. It is a name of Lord Indra, the God of Thunder and Rains in Hinduism. The name represents the power and strength of the divine and is believed to bring prosperity and good fortune. The name अमन carries the meaning “Immortal, Imperishable” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose अमन usually hope their child will grow to embody immortal, imperishable and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: अमन belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Immortal, Imperishable.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of अमन total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
